title: Discovery Engine: Link Feedback to Agent Tasks
summary: Discovery Engine now allows linking conversation feedback to specific Sobi agent tasks via a new `taskName` field. Minor internal scope adjustments were also made for `completeQuery` methods.
details: The `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1betaFeedbackConversationInfo` schema now includes an optional `taskName` field. This field, of type `string`, allows developers to associate conversation feedback with the full resource name of a Sobi task (e.g., `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/tasks/{task_id}`). This enhances traceability for conversations handled by long-running agent tasks. Additionally, the `completeQuery` methods across `dataStores` and `engines` had their required OAuth scopes (`cloud-platform` and `cloud_search.query`) reordered, which should have no functional impact on existing integrations.
